snippet.title: Fish Lab Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a look at the Demo Trailer for Fish Lab, an incremental game developed by Stone Codes. A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Upgrade by making discoveries . Synced to music. Fish Lab Demo is now on steam

Demo out now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4221990/Fish_Lab/
